summary: End-to-end frontend testing of Anniversary Adventure 3D game. Verified start screen, HUD, Scrapbook (button+keyboard), Mute toggle, '=' love debug, spacebar selfie, ']' summit teleport, and the full "'" ending cinematic (all 4 stages). Also confirmed 3D scene actually renders the summit environment with cherry blossoms, couple, bench, sunset lighting, and 'Ropeway Unlocked' HUD label. No console errors, no React errors, no WebGL fatal errors during the entire flow.

critical_code_review_comments: Loading.jsx: safety timeout of 8s hides LoadingScreen regardless of actual completion — acceptable UX guard but hides potential asset load failures silently; consider surfacing a warning in dev builds.

UI.jsx MuteButton: local muted state is decoupled from a global store; if audio needs to be muted from other components (e.g., during ending), toggle will drift. Consider promoting mute state to Zustand.

Game.jsx: mouse-wheel is captured globally to zoom camera per problem statement note — could interfere with any future scrollable modals (currently no scrollable panels beyond scrapbook-grid which has its own scroll).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This app is frontend-only (Zustand + R3F + Rapier). No backend URLs beyond REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for serving the SPA. If retesting, use debug keys: '=' (+100 love), ']' (teleport to summit), "'" (trigger 4-stage ending). Ending takes ~23s total. When clicking HUD buttons through Playwright, force=True can hit long implicit waits on canvas; prefer JS-dispatched clicks via page.evaluate() or wait 8-10s after HUD appears so the loading-hide animation completes and hud-btn pointer-events settle. All expected data-testids are wired correctly: start-btn, start-screen, hud-love, hud-journal-btn, hud-mute-btn, scrapbook, scrapbook-close, ending, love-letter, play-again-btn. In-world scene tests (bowling/boat/coaster/shooting/food) require WASD navigation to reach glowing rings and press E; automated exploration is impractical, so debug keys are the recommended path.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only test-level flakiness noted: page.click on hud-btn intermittently timed out (~30s) even though the click succeeded, likely due to Playwright waiting for network/canvas idle after firing the click. Workaround used: page.evaluate('() => document.querySelector(...).click()') which bypasses actionability checks and works reliably. This is a test-harness quirk, NOT an app bug.
